transactional_classes.TX_SUCCESS: complete verified epoch + target match + commit
transactional_classes.TX_TARGET_FAIL: target mismatch after a verified uninterrupted epoch
transactional_classes.TX_NO_RESULT_INVALIDATED: state invalidator fired; no scientific target conclusion
transactional_classes.TX_NO_RESULT_RECEIPT_GAP: legacy evidence cannot satisfy the B400 receipt token; fail closed
transactional_classes.TX_NONTERMINAL_VERIFIED: verified reset acquired but no target/commit exists in this evidence object
transactional_classes.TX_PRETRANSACTION: admission or natural initial-state observation; not a target result
transactional_classes.TX_OBSERVER_SUPPORT: supports receipt interpretation but is not itself a target transaction
